source: frozen 215-cell Morph cohort after the active 22-cell morphology/reconstruction quarantine
policy: The ten cells with unstable D1/D2 assignment remain in unsupervised morphology discovery.
D1/D2 instability is displayed as uncertain or grey only in transcriptomic-association analyses.
No transcriptomic or electrophysiological label is used to fit morphology preprocessing, PCA, HC, GC, bootstrap or consensus clustering.
